brief:
The head of Gaza's bus operators union warned Sunday that the public transport sector faces imminent collapse as approximately 70 percent of the territory's bus fleet sits idle, Shehab Wire reported. Union chief Anwar Abu Albeh said the crisis threatens to cripple mobility across the strip.

The shutdown reflects broader infrastructure strain across Gaza, where fuel shortages and maintenance challenges have disabled much of the transportation network serving the civilian population.

title: Gaza loses 70 percent of buses to service collapse
